bibl.title: Sarapis invoked as Zeus Dodonaios on a magical gem used for divinatory purposes.
bibl.seg: Christopher A. Faraone, Sarapis invoked as Zeus Dodonaios on a magical gem used for divinatory purposes.
Romanitas. Revista de Estudos Grecolatinos 9 (2017) pp. 138-146, figg.
bibl.note: Analyses the connection between some magical gems [in part. one seen on the antiquities market, Monte Carlo, 1982] bearing representations of Sarapis and the recipe for Sarapic oracle in P.G.M. V, 1-10.
